class: interrupted refresh leaves leftovers (release owner row)
problem: Refresh run 45985422058 left /tmp/pantheon-bounded-runtime-45985422058 (BR_PHASE=captured, BR_ENTER_COUNT=0, image three releases old and gone). Every later refresh restored from it, failed with bounded_runtime_stale_restore_failed and kept the record, so official market, chip and fundamentals refreshes failed (46075700478, 46078582392).

solution.never_entered: BR_PHASE != entered and BR_ENTER_COUNT=0 with no pantheon-bounded-refresh-* container: nothing is restored; if steady_posture_problem reports healthy the record is retired with reason never_entered, else it is restored as recorded.
solution.superseded_by_release: No bounded container and (running source-ingest image != BR_IMAGE_ID, or none of BR_STEADY_IDS exists): not restored to the recorded image; retired after the steady posture verifies healthy, naming recorded and current image ids. A record whose bounded runtime is in place restores as before.
solution.named_failure_parts: recorded_image_missing, source_ingest_restore, steady_container_start, container_counts, controller_mode (record_incomplete); the error reads bounded_runtime_stale_restore_failed: run_<id>:<part>; steady check reason steady_restore_failed:bounded_runtime:<parts>; the record is kept.
solution.retention_bound: Retired record directory is deleted after the receipt; the receipt line goes to the log and to pantheon-bounded-runtime-retired.log under the state root (name does not match the record glob), capped to the last 50 lines (BOUNDED_RUNTIME_RETIRED_LOG_LINES). At most one retirement per dead run; no new recurring job.
